name: app-factory
description: Portable AI software-development factory with autonomous context, capability-based execution, local learning and semantic verification.

interface.shortDescription: Recover context, execute, prove intent and learn safely.
interface.longDescription: A portable software-development factory that activates from software intent, recovers repository context and autonomous state, materializes semantic contracts for relevant work, routes each action to capable backends, uses GitHub CI for deterministic proof, requires decoupled semantic review when risk warrants it, and conservatively learns from privacy-safe local execution metadata without making Codex or any vendor mandatory.
defaultPrompt: Create a software system with App Factory and prove it against the intended behavior.
Resume this software project, use the safest capable backend and continue autonomously.
Use semantic contracts and execution evidence when relevant without adding unnecessary process.
